metadataReview.coordinateBasis: GeoNames 1787646 lists Yangcun, with the historical romanisation Yang-ts’un among its alternate names, as a populated place in Tianjin at latitude 39.36389, longitude 117.06028, rounded to [117.0603,39.3639]. Chaffee's report places the Chinese position about a mile and a half from Yangtsun in front of the railway bridge where the railway and river road converge, and the American advance continuing through villages east of Yang-tsun to nearly the north end of the town. The point is therefore a town-scale sector reference; it is not the railway bridge, the embankment assault or any unit position, and the growth of the modern town makes its centre only approximate for 1900. No accuracy radius is claimed.
